name: Operation Starfire-1
description:
Guerilla warfare does not preclude a frontal attack. Such a battle almost always leads to a decisive victory or a marked defeat. In this open terrain, who will benefit from this battle?
In this battle, Operator deployment is not restricted by melee/ranged designations.
<Roadblock> Deploy to block the enemy's route

tokens.name: Roadblock
tokens.description: Changes enemy routes and blocks up to three enemies. Enemies can destroy it when blocked. Retreat to clear the tile.
